Ravi: Scheduling a private <-> dedicated switchover for OrionTenant tonight 20:45 PT. Purpose: pin model runtime to v2026.03.1 for stability and move traffic to reserved pool. Need SRE + Ops + customer success ack. @Noemi @Kai
DeployBot: [deploybot] Rollout scheduled: orion-tenant-dedicated-pin -> 2026-03-21T20:45:00-07:00. Canary plan: 8% (10m) -> 40% (12m) -> 100% (18m). RunID db-roll-1769876543.
Noemi: Quick checklist please: exact rollback criteria, KV warm expectations, and whether we require manual final promote.
Ravi: From runbook: rollback triggers: (1) p99 latency +140ms over baseline for 3x1m buckets, (2) error rate >1% sustained 5m, (3) golden-prompt quality drop >2% absolute. KV cache warm goal: >70% prefix hit within 120s of pool activation. Final promote requires two approvers unless auto-policy shows green for 15m at 100%.
Kai: SRE note: last time we saw a transient p99 spike at stage boundaries due to cache churn. Request adding a 90s buffer after each stage before measuring p99 for rollback. Also want a small golden-prompt sample at 8% and 40%.
SRE-Bot: Added probe commands to playbook: `redwoodctl probe-kv --tenant orion --samples 80` and `redwoodctl eval --tenant orion --golden 25`. Automated hooks will run at stage start.
Ops: Ops will assert KMS hold before final promote. There's a key rotation scheduled 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z so no conflict but we still add hold for 24h. Command: `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant orion --until 2026-03-23`.
Marta: CS notified customer ops@orion; they asked for a short release note blurb and for us to include a rollback contact. I pushed release notes to: https://intranet.redwood/releases/orion-2026-03-21.
DeployBot: Preflight output for db-roll-1769876543:
```
- capacity-check: reserved pool 1.25x -> OK
- config-validate: OK
- kms-status: OK
- smoke-tests: 7/7 passed
- kv-probe (dry): timed probe scheduled at canary
- canary-policy: 8 -> 40 -> 100
```
Noemi: I updated the emergency rollback snippet to include force-drain and a tag: `redwoodctl rollback --tenant orion --to-version v2026.02.x --force --run-id db-roll-1769876543`. Also documented manual-approval flow: two approvers (one SRE, one Ops).
Kai: ACK from SRE. I'll be watching p99, cache hit-rate, and golden prompt diffs.
Ops: ACK from Ops. I'll take the KMS hold step and will be at the keyboard for final promote.
Marta: ACK from CS. Customer on standby for the window.
Ravi: Final GO/NO-GO cut at 20:30 PT. Please confirm here. We'll capture KV warm time and any small-signal latency at stage transitions in the post-roll notes.
Noemi: GO from SRE.
Kai: GO.
Ops: GO.
